frozen_before: any fetch of intraday bars, daily bars or quotes for this census
purpose: Test whether the AH->PM pattern behind the core strategy has a net edge in liquid names, where books are executable. Decides whether Initiative 7 builds a liquid AH-mover candidate.

universe.symbols: the cached point-in-time universe from log/2026-10-12/init7-reversal20-pit/universe.json.gz (Alpaca active+inactive NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX non-fund stocks plus S&P 500 members since 2016), with the same share-class folds
universe.membership: for an AH date D, the top 1000 symbols by the sum of monthly SIP vwap x volume over the three complete calendar months before D's month; names need monthly bars in all three months

dates: AH dates D are full-session trading days from 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30 per the Alpaca calendar; early-close days are skipped. D+1 is the next trading day.

ignition_long.move: close of the last SIP 5-minute bar starting 16:55 ET or earlier on D (after 16:00) divided by D's official close (raw daily bar), minus 1, is at least +3%
ignition_long.volume: SIP volume in 5-minute bars starting 16:05 through 16:55 ET (the 16:00 bar is excluded because it carries closing-auction prints) is at least 3x the median of the same window over the symbol's prior 20 AH dates (missing days count as 0 volume) and at least $1,000,000 by bar vwap x volume
ignition_long.events: one event per symbol per date

prices.entry: SIP NBBO ask of the last quote at or before 17:00:00 ET on D with timestamp after 16:55:00 ET; event dropped (and counted) if no quote, bid <= 0 or ask <= bid
prices.exit_0430: SIP NBBO bid of the last quote at or before 04:30:00 ET on D+1 with timestamp at or after 04:00:00 ET; if none valid, fall back to the D+1 official open minus 5 bps (counted)
prices.exit_open: D+1 official open (raw daily bar) minus 5 bps
prices.exit_close: D+1 official close (raw daily bar) minus 5 bps
prices.splits: drop an event if the ratio of raw to split-adjusted daily close changes between D and D+1
prices.stress: subtract a further 20 bps per round trip

statistics.unit: net return per event = exit / entry - 1
statistics.interval: bootstrap resampling AH dates with replacement (events on a date stay together), 4000 draws, seed 13
statistics.pass_per_exit: mean net > 0 AND lower bound of the two-sided 98.33% interval (Bonferroni over 3 exits) > 0 AND both chronological halves (split by AH date at the median event) have mean net > 0
statistics.passed: at least one exit passes at base cost; report stress too

descriptive_only: down movers (move <= -3% with the same volume test) as a short-fade and short-continuation view, move-size buckets (3-6%, 6-10%, >10%), entry spread distribution, events per month. None of these can rescue a failed pass.
decision_if_pass: freeze an executable variant (entry book checks, size, exit) and run it as a shadow ledger; propose to Juan through the daily email before any live change
decision_if_fail: the AH->PM continuation has no net edge in liquid names over the past year; record it and pick the next Initiative 7 universe or close the lane
